name: Spokes 6 XL
notes: After the Elektron Model:Cycles manual: six FM machines (kick, snare, metal, perc, tone, chord), each with pitch, decay, color, shape, sweep and contour, volume + dist, pan, delay and reverb sends and an LFO into its pitch; a delay (time, feedback) and a reverb (size, tone). Elektron does not publish the engines: what color, shape, sweep and contour do per machine follows the manual and reviews, not the original's code. No per-track swing or chance.
